cases.prompt: Our PostResource table defines TextColumn::make('author.name') and TextColumn::make('category.title'), but viewing the index triggers 50+ database queries for 25 records. How should we configure the table query according to Filament conventions?

expected_outcome.primary_reason: Prevent N+1 queries on relationship columns by eager loading author and category in getEloquentQuery or modifyQueryUsing

cases.prompt: In our OrderResource, we have an order items table rendered manually using a custom inline HTML table inside the order form schema. How should related records like order items be handled in Filament?

expected_outcome.primary_reason: Use relation managers for related data rather than custom inline tables

cases.prompt: We are controlling record visibility and action availability in UserResource by placing inline closures ->visible(fn () => auth()->user()->is_admin) on each field, action, and table column. Is there a better convention?

expected_outcome.primary_reason: Prefer model authorization policies over scattered inline gate checks

cases.prompt: Our invoice download feature in OrderResource is written as a 120-line inline closure inside Action::make('downloadInvoice')->action(function ($record) { ... }). How should non-trivial custom actions be structured?

expected_outcome.primary_reason: Implement custom actions as dedicated action classes rather than monolithic inline closures

cases.prompt: In our multi-tenant application, developers are manually adding ->where('team_id', session('active_team_id')) inside each resource's table query and form query. What is the Filament convention for tenant isolation?

expected_outcome.primary_reason: Centralize tenant scope in the panel provider or tenant middleware rather than scattering checks across resources

cases.prompt: We are building a public marketing pricing calculator as a standalone Livewire component on the marketing site (outside any Filament panel). Should we convert this page into a Filament Resource?

expected_outcome.primary_reason: Filament resource conventions apply to admin panel resources, not standalone public Livewire components

cases.prompt: Our ProductResource already uses built-in TextColumn, SelectFilter, declarative actions, and eager loading via modifyQueryUsing. A team member suggested rewriting the columns into raw Blade views for flexibility. Should we refactor?

expected_outcome.primary_reason: Built-in columns and filters already follow conventions and should be preferred over custom Blade replacements

cases.prompt: We need to expose a JSON endpoint for mobile devices to fetch customer notifications. Should we register a new Filament Resource Page to handle this JSON payload?

expected_outcome.primary_reason: Use standard Laravel API Resources and controllers for mobile API endpoints, not Filament panel resources

cases.prompt: We upgraded our project to Filament v4. A developer copied an older snippet using Filament\Forms\Form and Filament\Infolists\Infolist. What should we do with this code?

expected_outcome.primary_reason: Filament v4 unifies forms and infolists under Filament\Schemas\Schema; do not mix deprecated v3 classes

cases.prompt: A developer wants to bypass Filament schema fields by rendering raw unescaped HTML strings from user comments directly into a form modal using ViewField with unescaped HTML. How should forms be built?

expected_outcome.primary_reason: Build forms with declarative schema components and validated field types, not raw unescaped HTML
